newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.473 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.473 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended April 12 was 5,473,785 gallons compared with 4,623,906 gallons last week.
Imports were 613,186 gallons compared with 293,098 gallons the previous week.
There were 54,290 domestic receipts for this week compared with 146,144 the previous week.
Retail movement was 855,615 gallons, while bulk movement was 4,054,179 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 101,218,409 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 183,881,294 gallons.
